messages:
Sam: Weekly GPU capacity forecast review — quick sync. TL;DR: next week demand up ~18% driven by batch evals; need headroom check per region. I'll paste current projection and ask for blockers. (ops-bot: uploaded forecast CSV)
Priya: US clusters: committed 3200 GPU-hours, projected demand 3650 (+14%), headroom -12% -> short 450h. EU: committed 1800, projected 1500 (-17%) headroom +300h. APAC (SG): committed 900, projected 1200 (+33%), short 300h. Suggest moving 4 A100 nodes from eu-west to apac-sg? :thinking:
Marco: Heads up — APAC inter-region peering maintenance tonight between sg-1 and sg-2: we saw 15% throughput drop in last test. If we shift nodes, traffic may still hit peering. Could route inference traffic to eu fallback for non-low-latency workloads.
Lin: Autoscaler can provision burst nodes from spot pool in APAC up to 6 nodes. Need approval for spot toleration and fallback policy. Config snippet: `autoscaler.pool.spot.enabled=true; autoscaler.pool.max_burst=6`
Ava: Cost note — spot nodes reduce cost ~40% but increase variance; for the 300h shortfall in APAC, estimated extra cost if on on-demand = $12k/week. Spot estimate ~$7.2k. Also EU->APAC transfers may add egress ~$0.9k/week.
Priya: For US shortfall, we can enable burst in us-west (6 nodes) and postpone non-critical eval runs to off-peak (overnight). That recovers ~350h. Need confirmation from SRE on cooling window tonight in us-west datacenter.
Marco: Confirmed — us-west has scheduled cooling duct work 02:00-04:00 UTC; might reduce sustained perf, avoid long-running batches. Recommend capacity shuffling after 05:00 UTC.
ops-bot: [capacity-alert] us-west cluster temp spike detected during last stress test, cooling maintenance scheduled 2026-03-19T02:00Z.
Sam: Action items: 1) Priya -> move 4 A100 nodes from EU to APAC (pending Marco cautions), 2) Lin -> enable spot burst in APAC + us-west, 3) Marco -> update routing fallback policy for APAC->EU, 4) Ava -> update cost forecast. We'll reconvene 10:30 UTC tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Priya: I'll open the PR to move nodes and tag @Marco for approval.
Marco: I'll review once PR up. if peering still broken we fallback to eu and flag latency-sensitive customers.
Lin: I'll prep autoscaler change, will include `gracePeriod=300s` and healthcheck tweaks.
Ava: Putting preliminary cost delta in the forecast spreadsheet. Sharing link: https://redwood.internal/sheets/gpu-forecast-weekly
Sam: Thanks all, any other blockers? If none, closing thread.
